title: After upgrading openai-python to 3.x, import httpx fails, respx mocks stop working, or TLS verification breaks
symptoms: RESPX routes no longer intercept SDK requests and tests hit the network
CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED in slim containers or behind a TLS inspecting proxy
cause: openai-python 3.0.0 switched to HTTPX2 and stopped installing httpx and certifi. HTTPX2 trusts the operating system certificate store, and only HTTPX2 clients satisfy the type hints.
fix: Migrate custom clients and mocks to httpx2 equivalents, install system CA certificates or set SSL_CERT_FILE, and add httpx yourself only as a temporary bridge.
apply:
import httpx2
from openai import OpenAI, DefaultHttpx2Client
client = OpenAI(http_client=DefaultHttpx2Client(timeout=httpx2.Timeout(30.0)))
# TLS: export SSL_CERT_FILE=/etc/ssl/certs/ca-certificates.crt
